about: V4 audio slots and layers. VO is the hero; music ducks under speech; UI SFX sit below speech; transitions and ambience are separate layers. Each slot plays FINAL, else TEMP, else silence.

voiceover.text: Your company already has the answer.
voiceover.shows: A line gathers five Acme signals from the systems they live in.

voiceover.text: It's scattered across the systems where work happens.
voiceover.shows: The line breaks; every signal returns to its own system.

voiceover.text: People rebuild it by hand. Agents start without it.
voiceover.shows: PEOPLE copy by hand | AGENTS: empty session.

voiceover.text: NavisLabs turns those signals into one shared understanding.
voiceover.shows: NavisLabs mark + wordmark, then the line branches into the two products.

voiceover.text: Every email, meeting, document and message becomes a signal —
voiceover.shows: Live systems emit signals; they settle into memory.

voiceover.text: remembered, connected, and turned into what should happen next.
voiceover.shows: Memory → context → intelligence → decision → execution → outcome (building) → learning (next).

voiceover.text: Inside an organization, Navis Application is for people.
voiceover.shows: The organization → teams → people → Navis Application opens.

voiceover.text: It shows what changed — Acme's renewal moved.
voiceover.shows: Your attention → What changed: Acme's renewal moved.

voiceover.text: And why: every fact with its source, its time, and how fresh it is.
voiceover.shows: Why this matters → evidence rows with source, time, freshness → one customer state.

voiceover.text: It's waiting on you, so Navis drafts the reply.
voiceover.shows: Waiting on you → Review & reply → Review draft → the draft.

voiceover.text: A person decides.
voiceover.shows: Abhishek selects a sentence and writes his own.

voiceover.text: Then the company acts.
voiceover.shows: Approve & send → Sending → Gmail accepted → Reply sent.

voiceover.text: The same organization's agents use Navis Developer.
voiceover.shows: Light → dark: VS Code, Claude Code, the task; the agent lacks context.

voiceover.text: Invite the team. Connect once — MCP, API, SDK or CLI.
voiceover.shows: Add a member → Invited; claude mcp add → ✓ Connected; Console › Connect.

voiceover.text: The agent asks — and gets cited facts, with their freshness.
voiceover.shows: navis_get_relevant_context → five facts with source and freshness.

voiceover.text: Navis isn't the model. It supplies the company's truth.
voiceover.shows: SDK install + API call; 'No model is called'.

voiceover.text: Every request is checked against its permissions.
voiceover.shows: Authorized / own scope / denied → the exact refusal.

voiceover.text: The agent does the work, and the run is on record.
voiceover.shows: Diff → Runs → Run timeline.

voiceover.text: A solo builder gets a private workspace — and the work state carries into the next session.
voiceover.shows: For myself → Personal workspace → checkpoint → next session restores the work state.

voiceover.text: One organization. The person and the agent acted on the same event.
voiceover.shows: One organization, shared context; the Acme event reaches both products.

voiceover.text: Same facts. Same sources. Same freshness.
voiceover.shows: Same fact / source / freshness, macro by macro.

voiceover.text: One understanding. Two ways in.
voiceover.shows: Thesis; 'People + AI agents · one shared understanding'.

voiceover.text: Models change. Agents change. Tools change.
voiceover.shows: Agent clients swap; the line to NavisLabs holds.

voiceover.text: Your company keeps its history.
voiceover.shows: The compounding mechanism builds step by step.

voiceover.text: Company-owned. Model-neutral. Shared by people and agents.
voiceover.shows: Pillars under the mechanism.

voiceover.text: NavisLabs. The shared understanding for your organization.
voiceover.shows: End card: mark + wordmark, headline, both products, navislabs.in.

music.style: One continuous score: a low bed, a subtle pulse, precise developer rhythm, warmer human texture, a merged motif, quiet resolution, silence. No stock-corporate, no trailer drums, no 'AI' arpeggios, nothing that competes with a male voice (leave 120–350 Hz and 2–4 kHz open under speech).

sections.brief: restrained, almost silent: a low bed; the NavisLabs reveal at 10.5 s is carried by silence and one tonal SFX
subtle brand emergence under the products and the data flow
human / organizational: warm, unhurried, the person's decision
technical developer momentum: precise, light rhythm
convergence: the human and technical motifs meet; shared understanding
conviction / moat: steady, grounded, no riser
resolution under the end card, then silence

sfx.style: Understated, physical, quiet: keys, Enter, trackpad clicks, soft ticks; small precise confirmations; no whooshes on ordinary moves, no booms.

ambience.why: temp data-flow texture under S04; muted automatically once the final score is in (the score carries S04)
